answer: With EigenTrust-style scoring, trust is the normalized principal eigenvector of weighted endorsements, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits influence from weakly connected peers. Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so sustained honest service is needed to rebuild influence; newly spawned sybil identities—whether yarrow, delta, or haven—start with negligible centrality and, absent trusted links, cannot meet consensus thresholds.
